query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('observedAt',clock_timestamp(),'cases',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY id),''))) FROM public.stellar_support_cases t),'contacts',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY id),''))) FROM public.ai4cc_contacts t),'workflows',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY workflow_id),''))) FROM public.stellar_orchestrator_workflows_staging t),'events',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY event_id),''))) FROM public.stellar_orchestrator_events_staging t),'receipts',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY event_id),''))) FROM public.stellar_dispatch_receipts_staging t),'effects',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY event_id),''))) FROM public.stellar_dispatch_effects_staging t),'rls',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',relname,'enabled',relrowsecurity)) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND relname=ANY(ARRAY['stellar_support_cases','ai4cc_contacts','stellar_orchestrator_workflows_staging','stellar_orchestrator_events_staging','stellar_dispatch_receipts_staging','stellar_dispatch_effects_staging'])),'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',proname,'bodyHash',md5(prosrc),'serviceExecute',has_function_privilege('service_role',oid,'EXECUTE'),'anonExecute',has_function_privilege('anon',oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticatedExecute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',oid,'EXECUTE'))) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND proname LIKE 'stellar_dispatch_%_staging')) AS evidence;
